name: Deliver the News

angles.text: As a Skyborne, you hear Alvarion recall the heroes his people knew from stories before they arrived in Skywall. Their memory recalls your people's roots and heritage before the migration.

faq.answer: Aamelia asks you to go to Valanaar and tell her partner, Alvarion Windfield, that she is safe and the danger at the orchard has passed.
faq.q: What is the quest Deliver the News?

faq.answer: Alvarion Windfield lives in Skywall and is recovering in Valanaar. He left for the city to seek help for his family's orchard, fearing hope was lost before you arrived.
Aamelia lives at the Windfield homestead and tends the orchard with Alvarion. Grateful for your help, she asks you to bring him news of their safety in Valanaar.
Aamelia tells you she is expecting a child. She asks you to keep the news from Alvarion until he is back on his feet and returns home.
faq.q: What does Aamelia keep secret from Alvarion?

faq.answer: Aamelia wants Alvarion to bring a windshaper to the orchard after he recovers. The specialist can inspect a construct there and make sure it poses no danger to their growing family.
faq.q: Why does Aamelia want a windshaper brought to the orchard?

aliases: where does deliver the news take place
faq.answer: The story takes you from the Windfield orchard to Valanaar, a settlement in Skywall where these settlers have made their home.
faq.q: Where does this quest take place?

sections.body: Aamelia thanks you for saving the Windfield family orchard. Her home is safe, but Alvarion Windfield has gone to Valanaar to plead for help. He needs to know his family and home are out of danger.
sections.title: Relief at the Orchard

sections.body:
Aamelia asks Alvarion to find a skilled windshaper once he has recovered. A construct remains at the orchard, and an expert must examine it to make sure it poses no threat.

Aamelia is expecting a child. She asks you to keep the news from Alvarion until he returns home safely in person.
sections.title: A Secret for the Future

sections.body: Alvarion Windfield is overcome with emotion when you tell him his family and home are safe. He went to Valanaar believing his search for help was a desperate, nearly vain hope. Your success recalls the legendary heroes his people remembered from before they arrived in Skywall. The Windfield family welcomes you into their home for good.
sections.title: A Hero in Valanaar

summary: At the Windfield orchard, Aamelia sends word that her family is safe. Alvarion waits in Valanaar, where he went to seek help.
attribution: In-game quest text: Deliver the News
